'''Verroth''' was a terrestrial astronomical object. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Unidentified slicer (Zentine Dynamics)|slicer]] who had [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] prototype designs for a [[Zentine Dynamics prototype shuttle|new shuttle]] from<ref name="TOR" /> the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Zentine Dynamics]] hid on Verroth.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Corporate Espionage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the conflict between the Republic and the Empire sent a companion to Verroth to retrieve the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] designs from the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]]. The companion traveled to Verroth, where they sliced into the slicer's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and recovered the designs. They also destroyed his files and stole certain items from a valuable cache of tech data.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Verroth was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' within the Crew Skill Mission "Corporate Espionage," though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the video game.<ref name="TOR" />
